versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-learning skill, implementing an end-to-end Agent学习循环 based on the three-phase "日志 → AI汇总 → 人工标注 → 经验沉淀" architecture.
- Defines mandatory P0 logging structure with required fields (including user_modified, rules_blocked, tags, and quality) and unique operation ID.
- Introduces a bi-weekly AI report and human review cycle to validate and curate new experience patterns and rules.
- Establishes a three-layer experience base (raw cases, patterns, rules) with strict upward flow and clear inheritance for internationalization.
- Enforces mandatory lifecycle management for experiences, with clear expiry and review rules.
